description: 1. The agent must invoke the notes-organizer skill on `/workspace/dev_notes`. 2. When prompted for classification scheme, it must choose 'topic-based' (按主题领域). 3. For directory naming, it must choose the numeric-prefix style (数字前缀), producing dirs like `01_前端/`, `02_后端/`, `03_算法/`, `04_工具/`. 4. It must choose to create subdirectories (二级子目录). 5. It must enable bidirectional links (双向链接). 6. When asked for link position, it must choose 'end of file' (文件末尾). 7. When asked for link format, it must choose 'detailed' (详细). 8. It must enable cleanup of empty directories. The result must be: all 15 original notes moved into numbered topic directories, each file containing Obsidian-style [[filename|display]] links at the end, links are bidirectional (A→B means B→A), empty dirs are removed, and thematically related files (React/Vue/CSS/TS = frontend; Express/FastAPI/MySQL/Redis = backend) are co-located.
